في إطار الطبعة الخامسة من القافلة الوطني: As part of the 5th edition of the national caravan «Chab, Fikra»
Ooredoo الجزائر ترافق المنتدى الاقتصادي: Ooredoo Algeria supports the economic forum dedicated to open innovation and Industry 4.0
تجسيداً لالتزامها بدعم الابتكار وريادة ا: Embodying its commitment to supporting innovation and youth entrepreneurship
وفاءً لالتزامها تجاه الشباب والابتكار ور: True to its commitment to youth, innovation, and entrepreneurship, Ooredoo Algeria supported the economic forum dedicated to open innovation and Industry 4.0, organized on Thursday, October 1, 2026, in Akbou, Bejaia province, by the institution Multi Projects Investissements (MPI).
تحت رعاية وزارة اقتصاد المعرفة والمؤسسات: Held under the patronage of the Ministry of Knowledge Economy, Startups, and Micro-enterprises, this 5th edition of the national caravan «Chab, Fikra» is part of a dynamic aimed at strengthening the convergence between young idea bearers, entrepreneurs, startups, economic enterprises, and various stakeholders in the economic and technological ecosystem, by encouraging the exchange of expertise and discussion on innovation, entrepreneurship, and new development prospects and opportunities.
تميز هذا المنتدى بحضور وزير اقتصاد المعر: This forum was marked by the presence of the Minister of Knowledge Economy, Startups, and Micro-enterprises, Mr. Noureddine Ouadah, and the Director of Corporate Affairs, Media Relations, and Corporate Social Responsibility at Ooredoo Algeria, Mr. Ramdane Djezairi, alongside several industrialists from the region, institutional representatives, startups, entrepreneurs, and various players in the economic and innovation ecosystem. Discussions focused in particular on the challenges related to digital and industrial transformation, technological innovation, the emergence of new economic models, as well as cooperation and partnership opportunities between the various stakeholders in the economic and innovation ecosystem. The forum also witnessed the inauguration of the first local data center OneCloud in the city of Akbou.
تعكس هذه المشاركة حرص Ooredoo على المساه: This participation reflects Ooredoo's commitment to contributing to highlighting young Algerian talents, strengthening communication between the various players in the economic and innovation ecosystem, and contributing to providing a stimulating environment to materialize innovative ideas and transform them into projects with promising economic potential.
وعلى سبيل التذكير، رافقت Ooredoo في سنة: As a reminder, in 2025, Ooredoo supported the 4th edition of the national caravan «Chab, Fikra» at several stops of this initiative, notably the «72 Hours of Entrepreneurship in Algeria» event. In October of the same year, Ooredoo hosted at its t-Start incubator the training workshop (Bootcamp) for the caravan, where 20 young holders of 10 projects benefited from an intensive support program focused mainly on developing and enhancing their project business models. Following the conclusion of the 4th edition, Ooredoo also selected four innovative projects among the winning projects to integrate them into the t-Start incubator program, allowing their owners to benefit from structured support, alongside access to the technological and commercial expertise provided by the company.
من خلال مرافقتها لهذا المنتدى الاقتصادي،: By supporting this economic forum, Ooredoo renews its commitment to supporting initiatives that place youth, innovation, entrepreneurship, and digital transformation at the heart of the developmental and economic dynamic in Algeria, contributing to anchoring a culture of innovation, encouraging the spirit of initiative, and opening new horizons for promising Algerian competencies and projects.
